findings.title: delta_epistemic_judgment
findings.claim: The closing names become an epistemic and judicial counterweight: reports may be sincere yet bounded, so the speaker diagnoses a recurrent inward cause without treating the reported event as exhaustive reality.
findings.mechanism: Before: The closing names generally affirm that God knows and acts wisely. Hidden reaction, outward description, testimony explicitly limited to what was known, an unguarded unseen, and asserted truth distinguish sincere report from exhaustive knowledge. The closing names therefore govern judgment under an evidence gap rather than merely ornamenting hope.
findings.reader_payoff: It makes the closing names legible as a judgment of reports under incomplete evidence.
findings.containment: The packet supplies hiddenness, representation, bounded testimony, unseen remainder, and claimed truth; I infer that the closing names authorize event-level judgment beyond public evidence. A live alternative is that the names offer general reassurance without defining an evidentiary method. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: delta_non_substitutionary_wholeness
findings.claim: Integral return also rejects substitutionary restoration: no relative is exchanged for another, and no one remains as collateral or residue.
findings.mechanism: Before: Integral return means that every absent person eventually arrives. An offered one-for-one replacement and a rule restricting custody to the implicated person establish a piecemeal economy of persons. Against that sequence, جَمِيعًا carries a no-substitute and no-remainder force.
findings.reader_payoff: It makes “all together” register against the pericope’s substitutions and restricted custody.
findings.containment: The packet supplies singular substitution, a replacement place, restricted custody, and total gathering; I infer that total return negates the exchange logic that has divided the family. A live alternative is that جَمِيعًا is only a numerical quantifier with no contrastive force. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: delta_directed_lament
findings.claim: Beautiful patience means withholding accusatory or despairing discharge toward the sons while allowing intense lament and full disclosure toward God.
findings.mechanism: Before: Beautiful patience means maintaining silence and suppressing grief. The speaker turns away, laments loss, is physically altered by grief, and holds pressure inward; he then explicitly manifests complaint and discloses hidden anguish to God. Beautiful patience regulates audience and direction, not the existence of grief or speech.
findings.reader_payoff: It preserves grief and complaint while clarifying why patience is called beautiful.
findings.containment: The packet supplies separation of audience, lament, pressure, complaint, and Godward disclosure; I infer that patience is selective channel discipline. A live alternative is that lament merely coexists with patience and does not explain its internal mechanism. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: delta_active_search
findings.claim: Trust in divine arrival sustains active evidence-seeking: present absence is not treated as terminal, so patience generates search instead of inertia.
findings.mechanism: Before: The speaker patiently waits for an arrival only God can cause. The command to track news through perception, joined to a doubled refusal to sever hope and a repeated image of divine relief, turns the hoped-for arrival into a search-governing possibility rather than passive waiting.
findings.reader_payoff: It turns waiting into a posture that can direct search.
findings.containment: The packet supplies continued steadiness, trace-seeking, prohibited despair, and relief; I infer that the hope of arrival licenses practical investigation. A live alternative is that the search is a separate pragmatic command rather than an enactment of the focus's patience. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: delta_protective_preservation
findings.claim: Patience is protective preservation across an unresolved interval: it keeps moral action and its eventual yield from being lost before knowledge emerges.
findings.mechanism: Before: Patience prevents a bad reaction during one crisis. Later ignorance is exposed, then self-protection and patience are explicitly paired with a result that is not lost. Patience thus preserves moral yield across delayed resolution rather than merely reducing immediate distress.
findings.reader_payoff: It extends patience across delay, preserving conduct and yield until disclosure.
findings.containment: The packet supplies exposed ignorance and a direct protection-patience-no-loss sequence; I infer that the focus's patience preserves action and value through delayed disclosure. A live alternative is that the later maxim applies primarily to Joseph and only analogically illuminates Jacob's earlier posture. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: delta_nonretaliatory_beauty
findings.claim: Beautiful also describes how vindication is handled afterward: accumulated injury does not become accumulated reproach.
findings.mechanism: Before: Beautiful describes how loss is endured before vindication. Confession of culpable error is followed not by retaliatory blame but by removal of reproach, covering of fault, and mercy. The beauty of patience can therefore be read prospectively as the form that vindication will take when power and knowledge finally arrive.
findings.reader_payoff: It lets the beauty of patience remain visible in the form of later vindication.
findings.containment: The packet supplies culpability followed by non-reproach and mercy; I infer a cross-speaker family parallel in which the earlier patience is beautiful partly because vindication does not mature into revenge. A live alternative is that Joseph's later response should not be used to define Jacob's phrase. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: delta_embodied_reassembly
findings.claim: The return is an embodied reassembly: mediated contact restores the father's capacity to encounter, then the household arrives as a whole.
findings.mechanism: Before: God may bring all the absent persons back to the speaker. A garment is physically cast upon the face, sight returns, and the whole household is commanded to come. The focus's hoped-for gathering becomes an embodied chain of mediation that repairs the perceiver and reassembles the relation, not merely transport of absent bodies.
findings.reader_payoff: It lets return appear as contact, restored perception, and restored household relation.
findings.containment: The packet supplies the garment-face-sight sequence and then an exact coming-and-totality reprise; I infer that 'all' can activate relational wholeness, including repair of the waiting father, beyond the pronoun's immediate persons. A live alternative is that بِهِمْ remains grammatically limited to the absent sons and that restored sight is only adjacent. The focus’s ordinary sense remains in place; this is a contextual inference, not a replacement reading.

findings.title: outlier_valved_grief
findings.claim: As a contained material analogy, beautiful patience behaves like a selective valve: it closes retaliatory discharge toward the sons while opening inward pressure toward God.
findings.mechanism: Before: Patience seals grief so that it does not emerge. The focus branch for صَبْر as a stopper meets the later containment of كَظِيم and the Godward disclosure of بَثّ, so restraint becomes selective rather than undifferentiated suppression.
findings.reader_payoff: It supplies a bounded material image for grief that is withheld from the sons and opened toward God.
findings.containment: This is surprising because it links a stopper and a filled, sealed outlet to emotional practice. It remains anchored in صَبْر and the later containment-to-disclosure sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for selective release, not as the lexical meaning of صَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus carrier and pericope contacts support the bounded image, but the cross-domain relation is exploratory and the HFT trace remains legacy_unbound.
